options.text: Decreasing the numerator while keeping the denominator the same
Increasing the denominator while keeping the numerator the same
Increasing the numerator while keeping the denominator the same
Multiplying both the numerator and denominator by the same number

Understanding this relationship prevents dosage errors when comparing fractional amounts.

rationales.whyCorrect: First find the volume: 4 mg / (2 mg/mL) = 2 mL. That 2 mL must go in over 10 minutes, so scale to one hour: 2 mL x (60 min / 10 min) = 12 mL/hr.
